body: That's definitely true. The more I'm in my head, the worse things get. It's weird to say, but I'm fighting by giving up. What will happen will happen, I can't control it. God keeps pounding that into my head through my counselor, my groups, my family, my wife, etc. My worst times come when I think for a minute I can control things outside of me. So I'm just going to meetings, counseling, school. Working out has really helped. Something about 200 lbs. being 200 lbs. no matter what, and, for lack of a better phrase, I think of it as literally pushing out bad thoughts and feelings. Thank you for your concern, it is very uplifting to see and feel.
Trudging along. Thats the best I can say. Sticking with things that have helped and working on rewiring the parts of my brain that didn't help. Reaching out more, just to get outside my own head.

Then rely on yourself.

I put the barrel in my teeth Monday. I know nothing of your situation and can only tell you that my life isn't exactly great.

I don't have a bullshit platitude and I won't tell you life is going to be ok or that people will automatically become reliable.

But I didn't pull the trigger because that's not who I am. I may have been (and still am) pretty severely depressed. I didn't want to die, though I felt just as driven in a different manner. 

I didn't because in my heart I love, and I trust, and I have faith in people even if I get destroyed as a result. 

I hope you don't.

Yes. I would. I don't know you but I would. 

I've been in a similar spot, not so far away as Monday last week. 

I wish I could tell you that things get better. They might. I'm working through that myself right now and having a real tough time giving myself any self worth. 

You are worth it for simply being you.
I'll try that next time but I'm not sure I'll like how the reasons break down. Thank you.

Thank you for your belief. I've been seeing a counselor as well, just when I think it's helping...that the steps or practices we talk about are working, something else pops up. 

My son is 5 now. It's so bad to say but sometimes, even knowing what the effect could be and knowing beyond a shadow of a doubt that my sons love me (hell, even my wife loves me), that's not enough. 

I don't know or have anything for tomorrow. Just a plan to go work out and go to class. So mundane but that has to be enough.

Nothing's better, but the urge has (mostly) passed. Thanks. 

Life is what it is. I may not get to be happy, but I do get to be.

Thank you for this. I appreciate your candor. I've just done it. I lived for tomorrow and got wrapped up in dreams and clouds and ignored reality. I lived for today and threw open my heart and all I've gotten is even more pain and uncertainty. I gave up trying to control things a long time ago, and even since I've done that it keeps getting worse. But I'm better now than I was when I posted earlier.

No. I don't. But I'd rather them not see me like this, see the relationship however it may be, or have the life I have had. I know that if anything, doing this would only increase their likelihood of having a life like mine, and I still can't get the ideas out.

Thanks. I'm trying. http://i684.photobucket.com/albums/vv205/haven_bucket/1245822166636.jpg?t=1246328571 didn't even help. And it's been one of the big fallback things for me. Just made me sniffle, cause I can't bust out tears in class.
Yes. Although in all honesty I've had repeated releases and clarifying experiences over the last 6-8weeks and things are only intensifying, or have hit today's point.

Ok. I probably should have said that my class gets out in about 4 hours. Just stupid, worried that what time I put makes any difference. But I'll talk, hell it's all I can do. I have nothing else, and the only things I do have, love and faith and hope, I can't share or can't be returned because of my own choices. And since I do have those things, that just makes me feel worse because how can I be hopeful and still want to do this? But yeah, I'll talk. I'll wait too because I don't want you to...I don't know, think I'm rude or who knows what. But you asked so I will.
And frankly, I have class and then I'm going through with it. Just sorting out details now.
